description:
I WOULD LIKE TO APPLY FOR A FAST TRACK SERVICE 

As per the attached plans, we would like to extend the rear of the existing property by 2m, to create a larger kitchen and dining area. This will then make the total length of the rear extension, from the back of the original house to end of the extension, 6m long.  
We would like to add in two new roof lights (as indicated in the plans), these would be flat roof lights not roof lanterns. 
The roof height would remain unaffected and would not be raised, so the internal ceiling height would remain 2,4m and the existing flat roof (hot roof) would be extended out.
decision_conditions: The proposed single storey rear extension and the total enlargement would extend beyond a wall forming a side elevation of the original dwellinghouse and would have a width greater than half the width of the original dwellinghouse contrary to Class A.1 (ja) and (j) (iii) of Class A, Part 1, Schedule 2 of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (as amended).

It has not been demonstrated that the proposal would comply with Condition A.3 (a) (materials used in any exterior work shall be of a similar appearance to those used in the construction of the exterior of the existing dwellinghouse) of Class A, Part 1, Schedule 2 of the Town and Country Planning(General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (as amended).

Due to the submission of inconsistent and contradictory plans Officers are unable to fully assess the impact of the proposed development on the neighbouring amenities.  The applicant has therefore failed to demonstrate, through the submission of cogent information, that the proposed development would not have an unacceptable adverse impact in terms of character and appearance, in conflict with Policy D3 of the London Plan (2021) and Policies CS8 and DM10 of the Core Strategy.
